_readme: Every value without a default must be filled in before the site will build. Keys starting with _ are notes. Optional: abn, supportHours, shopifyHomeVisitVariantId, gaMeasurementId, metaPixelId (elements marked data-if are hidden when their value is empty).
cancellationPolicy: You can reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before your appointment. Changes made within 24 hours of the appointment, or a missed visit, may incur the home visit fee.
